description: Synthetic email threads with the due date, and the day of the event each is about, that a reader would give each; a case without expected_event_on expects no event. Dates are absolute, so the suite needs no fixed clock: every message carries the day it was written.

messages.text: Please return the signed vendor contract by November 12.
